description: This file defines configuration schemas, default settings, normalization functions, and utility methods for a Diff plugin in the OpenClaw project. It manages plugin configuration, security, viewer URL validation, and rendering options for diff images.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredValue
methods.description: Selects a configuration value based on primary, aliases, and default schema value.

methods.name: buildDiffsPluginConfigShape
methods.description: Constructs the full plugin configuration object, resolving viewer URL, defaults, and security settings.

methods.name: resolveDiffsPluginDefaults
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes default diff plugin settings from a given configuration object.

methods.name: resolveDiffsPluginSecurity
methods.description: Resolves and returns security configuration, specifically the allowRemoteViewer flag.

methods.name: resolveDiffsPluginViewerBaseUrl
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the viewer base URL from configuration.

methods.name: toPresentationDefaults
methods.description: Converts internal diff plugin defaults to presentation defaults for UI display.

methods.name: normalizeFontFamily
methods.description: Normalizes font family string, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeFontSize
methods.description: Normalizes font size within allowed range.

methods.name: normalizeLineSpacing
methods.description: Normalizes line spacing within allowed range.

methods.name: normalizeFileQuality
methods.description: Validates and normalizes file quality preset.

methods.name: normalizeFileScale
methods.description: Normalizes file scale within allowed range.

methods.name: resolveDiffImageRenderOptions
methods.description: Determines rendering options for diff images based on provided parameters and defaults.
